Study flows and pipeline

wgh_flow_canalization()
Flow: canalization, catch-up and catch-down (Ho 2026, manuscript under review)
wgh_flow_conditional_references()
Flow: conditional growth references (Ho 2026, medRxiv 2026.09.23.26363771)
wgh_flow_distributional_height()
Flow: BMI and the height-for-age distribution (Ho 2026, medRxiv 2026.09.08.26362487)
wgh_flow_explain_prediction()
Flow: explainable individual growth prediction (Ho 2026, manuscript under review)
wgh_flow_growth_inequality()
Flow: growth inequality, the spread of height by BMI (Ho 2026, manuscript under review)
wgh_flow_growth_phenotypes()
Flow: growth phenotypes by functional clustering (Ho 2026, medRxiv 2026.09.05.26362315)
wgh_flow_height_prediction()
Flow: predicting late-adolescent height (Ho 2026, manuscript under review)
wgh_flow_index_trajectory()
Flow: prepubertal BMI and the height trajectory (Ho et al. 2026, medRxiv 2026.07.26.26358003)
wgh_flow_malnutrition_trends()
Flow: stunting, thinness, obesity and double burden (Ho et al. 2026, medRxiv 2026.07.26.26358982)
wgh_flow_phenotype_outcomes()
Flow: growth phenotypes and later outcomes, growth side (Ho 2026, manuscript in preparation)
wgh_flow_pubertal_spurt()
Flow: the pubertal growth spurt by SITAR (Ho et al. 2026, medRxiv 2026.07.26.26358986)
wgh_flow_secular_trends()
Flow: secular trends, prevalence and regional differences (Ho et al. 2026, Sci Rep 16:7515)
wgh_flow_spurt_duration()
Flow: duration of the pubertal spurt (Ho 2026, medRxiv 2026.09.09.26362696)
wgh_flow_velocity_distribution()
Flow: prepubertal BMI and the distribution of pubertal velocity (Ho 2026, medRxiv 2026.09.04.26362313)
wgh_use_pipeline()
Write a targets pipeline that chains the paper flows
